description: A man in a dark doublet with a white ruff collar and a brown leather apron stands in a dim workshop, holding a brass-and-leather tube to his eye and looking out a leaded-glass window toward a church spire and rooftops. A workbench in the foreground holds lenses, brass fittings and tools, and shelves on the left hold pots and instruments. The clothing and workshop suggest the early 1600s; there are no visible letters, numbers, frame or border, and nothing graphic.
